product_overview: A web application to let borrowers request equipment for a date range, track request status with a tracking ID, and allow staff/admin to review approvals and record returns. Public tracking and borrower history pages provide transparency while admins manage request lifecycle.
core_goals: Allow borrowers to select borrow and return dates, choose equipment, submit a borrow request, and receive a tracking ID.
Enable borrowers to view their request history and look up any request by Tracking ID to see current status.
Allow borrowers to cancel requests while they remain pending.
Provide staff/admin a workflow to review, approve or reject requests with reasons and record return outcomes (full/partial/damaged).
Prevent double-booking by enforcing availability rules across the selected date range.

features.name: Borrow Request Submission
features.description: Borrowers select a date range, find equipment, add items and quantities to a cart, provide borrower details, and submit a request to receive a tracking ID.
user_flows: Navigate to /borrow.html -> Select start and end dates -> Filter and search equipment -> Add items to cart and set quantity -> Fill borrower information and confirm submit -> See submission success page (/success.html) with Tracking ID summary
Navigate to /borrow.html -> Select start and end dates where start is after end -> Attempt to confirm submit -> See validation error about date range and correct the dates

Navigate to /borrow.html -> Select start and end dates -> Filter and search equipment -> Add an item with quantity greater than available for the selected range -> Attempt to confirm submit -> See validation error about available quantity and adjust quantities

features.name: Tracking Lookup and Cancel Pending Request
features.description: Any user can look up a borrow request by Tracking ID to view details and cancel the request if its status is still pending.
user_flows: Navigate to /tracking.html -> Enter Tracking ID and search -> Review request details and item list -> If status is pending, initiate cancellation and confirm cancellation -> See confirmation that cancellation was submitted

Navigate to /tracking.html -> Enter Tracking ID and search -> Review request details and item list -> If status is not pending, attempt to cancel -> See an explanation that cancellation is not allowed for the current status

features.name: Borrower History
features.description: Authenticated borrowers can view a list of their recent requests, open details, and jump to tracking information for a selected request.
user_flows: Navigate to /history.html -> Sign in as borrower -> View recent request history list -> Open details for a selected request -> Jump to /tracking.html to view tracking details
Navigate to /history.html -> Sign in as borrower -> View recent request history -> Select a request and verify shown dates, items, and current status

features.name: Admin Moderation (Approve/Reject & Return Processing)
features.description: Admins sign in to the admin console to review pending requests, approve or reject with reasons, and record return outcomes (full, partial, damaged) per item.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/index.html -> Log into admin panel -> Navigate to /admin/dashboard.html -> Review pending borrow requests -> Approve a request and record an approval note -> See the request updated to approved status

Navigate to /admin/index.html -> Log into admin panel -> Navigate to /admin/dashboard.html -> Review a request -> Reject the request and provide a rejection reason -> See the request updated to rejected status

Navigate to /admin/index.html -> Log into admin panel -> Navigate to /admin/dashboard.html -> Open a returned request -> Record return outcomes per item (returned, returned_pending_inspection, damaged) -> See return result recorded in request history
